summary: This is a press release announcing a strategic collaboration between ARTAN Bio and Syenex, in which Syenex will provide access to its VivoCell Platform for precision in vivo delivery of ARTAN's lead drug candidate, ARTAN-102, a codon suppressor therapeutic targeting aging and age-related disease. The collaboration aims to accelerate ARTAN's program from in vitro proof-of-concept to IND-enabling studies. No quantitative experimental data is disclosed.

content_blocks.title: Partnership Announcement Overview
content_blocks.content: ARTAN Bio and Syenex announced a strategic collaboration on June 6, 2025. Syenex will provide ARTAN access to the VivoCell Platform — a precision in vivo delivery technology — to support development of delivery vehicles for ARTAN's lead drug, ARTAN-102 (a codon suppressor). The collaboration is structured as a non-exclusive program license option. The stated goal is to accelerate the program from in vitro proof-of-concept to IND-enabling studies in a capital-efficient manner.

content_blocks.title: ARTAN-102 Program Stage and Mechanism
content_blocks.content: ARTAN-102 is described as a 'first-in-class' codon suppressor therapeutic. The mechanism involves restoring full-length, functional proteins involved in aging and age-related disease — likely targeting nonsense mutations or premature stop codons via codon suppression. The program is currently at in vitro proof-of-concept stage, with the next milestone being IND-enabling studies. Syenex's CEO references 'strong preclinical data on the therapeutic potential of ARTAN-102,' but no specific data, assays, or quantitative results are disclosed in this document.

content_blocks.title: Collaboration Scope and Development Activities
content_blocks.content: Three components of the collaboration are described: (1) Rapid Prototyping — access to the complete VivoCell Platform including libraries of precision delivery components, with Syenex providing pre-clinical scale prototyping and production support; (2) Manufacturing Scale-Up — prototypes to be transferred to Syenex's CDMO partner for GMP scale-up; (3) Option Rights — non-exclusive Program License option for the clinical delivery vehicle composition. Financial terms were not disclosed. This indicates the program is in early preclinical/delivery optimization phase, not yet at GMP or IND stage.

content_blocks.title: Company Backgrounds and Capabilities
content_blocks.content: ARTAN Bio: Community-backed biotech developing therapeutics to reverse epigenetic changes associated with aging and age-related disease. Research supported by a decentralized scientific community. CEO: Anthony Schwartz. CSO/Co-Founder: Dr. Michael Torres. Syenex: Open-science biotechnology platform company founded in 2022. Provides plug-and-play delivery platforms (ex vivo and in vivo) spanning discovery through GMP manufacturing. Has over 50 partnerships with biopharma and academia. CEO: Jay Rosanelli. Syenex's track record in delivery vehicle innovation and manufacturing scale is cited as a key rationale for the partnership.

The program is currently at in vitro proof-of-concept stage; the next development milestone is IND-enabling studies.

Delivery vehicle development is a current bottleneck — the collaboration is explicitly aimed at solving the in vivo delivery challenge for the codon suppressor platform.
